acceptance_criteria_checklist.criterion: normalize_whitespace collapses runs of spaces, tabs, and newlines into a single space.
acceptance_criteria_checklist.evidence:
normalize_whitespace('  a		b

c   d  ') returned 'a		b

c  d' — tabs/newlines untouched, triple-space only partially collapsed.

acceptance_criteria_checklist.criterion: Leading and trailing whitespace is stripped.
acceptance_criteria_checklist.evidence: str.strip() is called first and does handle this part correctly.

acceptance_criteria_checklist.criterion: A unit test exercises tabs/newlines/multi-space input, not just a single simple case, and passes.
acceptance_criteria_checklist.evidence: The only test in tests/test_text_utils.py checks a single double-space case; no tab/newline/multi-space coverage exists.

summary: Only 1 of 3 acceptance criteria met. The str.replace-based implementation doesn't handle tabs, newlines, or 3+ consecutive spaces; the accompanying test is too narrow to have caught this.
